## D.8 / H3: profiles

See `reports/v1.0_optimizer.md` §1 and `reports/scenarios_v0.2.md`: optimal food sets differ by goal mainly through protein density (fat loss → lean animal foods and dairy) and the price-insensitive objective (→ compact foods); all cost-minimizing profiles share the legume + grain core.
